# Mohd Rizwan (iamrizwan.com)

> "I like being near people building something real."
> Founder, Product Builder, and UX Enhancement Specialist based in Dehradun, India.

---

## 1. Identity & Overview

- **Full Name**: Mohd Rizwan (often referred to simply as Rizwan)
- **Primary Website**: https://iamrizwan.com
- **Location**: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India
- **Core Focus**: Product Experience (PX), User Experience (UX) Enhancement, MVP Scoping, and AI Knowledge Infrastructure.
- **Parent Company**: RKO Services Private Limited (Founded 2023, https://rkospl.com)

Mohd Rizwan works directly with startup founders and builders to diagnose product friction, optimize onboarding flows, and eliminate churn bottlenecks. Having built companies solo, scaled a startup to 32 people, and managed the hard reality of shutting it down, he offers grounded, battle-tested product guidance with zero vanity advice.

---

## 2. Core Philosophy & Working Style

- **No Vanity Advice**: Avoids vague corporate jargon, bloated discovery phases, and lengthy slide decks.
- **Ordered Priorities**: Delivers a short, ranked list of high-impact fixes. "Ordered matters more than long."
- **Deep Focus**: Treats the client's product with the same rigor, care, and ownership as his own ventures.
- **Key Positioning**: Helps founders who are either:
  1. *Pre-Product / MVP Scoping*: Preventing over-engineering and designing a crisp first-time user experience without bloat.
  2. *Live Product / UX Audit*: Diagnosing where users drop off, catching broken onboarding flows, and increasing retention.

---

## 3. Venturing History & Track Record (Transparent)

### Tharom AI (Active Venture — https://tharom.com)
- **Status**: Active (Building solo, open for early access registration).
- **Description**: AI infrastructure for organizations with proprietary knowledge bases. Keeps expert humans in the loop, allowing "knowledge owners" to let their users learn from verified knowledge with controlled and monitored AI capabilities.

### TIME (Active Venture — https://time.rkospl.com)
- **Status**: Active.
- **Description**: Time allocation, tracking, and live availability platform built for founders and builders looking to spend time wisely, maintain clear records, and share live availability pages.

### Xapproach (MVP Built — https://xapproach.com)
- **Status**: Paused for legal and financial compliance.
- **Description**: Pay-per-minute educational marketplace tailored for the Indian market. Enables educators to monetize video lessons on a strict per-minute viewing model (e.g., ₹1/minute, pay only for exact seconds watched).

### Humgrow (2024–2025)
- **Status**: Shut down in July 2025.
- **Description**: An all-in-one super app for recruitment, ATS, HRM, and freelance marketplace. Scaled to a team of 32 people and signed 20+ enterprise contracts with leading banks and NBFCs within one year. Scaled team and overhead ahead of product readiness; shut down directly by Rizwan when runway ended. Formative founder experience that informs his ability to spot fatal startup traps early.

### The Networker (2018–2023)
- **Status**: Consolidated into RKOSPL in 2023.
- **Description**: Solo recruitment business founded before COVID-19. Operated with zero employees and zero office, placing over 2,500+ candidates (conservative count) and generating up to ₹2.5L/month by out-delivering traditional recruitment vendors.

## 4. Services Offered

### Time-as-a-Service (Product & UX Enhancement)
- **URL**: https://iamrizwan.com/services
- **Model**: Direct 1-on-1 founder advisory. One focused conversation reviewing the live product or MVP draft, delivering 2–3 actionable fixes in exact priority order.
- **Pricing**: No fixed rate card; aligned on fair mutual value after assessing the specific scope and challenge.
- **Schedule**: https://cal.com/meet-rizwan

### Reviews & Founder Testimonials
- **URL**: https://iamrizwan.com/reviews
- **Description**: Real testimonials and feedback from founders, CTOs, and builders who have worked directly with Rizwan on product audits, UX optimization, and MVP scoping.
- **Verification**: Public reviews can be submitted directly on the website and are verified before publishing. Live testimonials can be viewed directly at https://iamrizwan.com/reviews.

### Resources & Blueprints
- **URL**: https://iamrizwan.com/resources
- **Description**: Curated directory of practical checklists, playbooks, tools, and guides for founders, MVP builders, and early-stage product teams. Includes actionable frameworks for UX audits, onboarding retention, and MVP scoping.
